'''Ado Eemon''' was the silver-tongued<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|226|Eemon, Ado}}</ref> ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caramm V/Legends|Caramm V]]<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Caramm system/Legends|Caramm system]]</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. After Eemon seceded to the Confederacy during the war,<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> the government utilized his world's large [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing facilities]], which helped to supply [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]]<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;emblazoned with Eemon's triple-spiraled sponsorship emblem on their [[hull]]s<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />&mdash;to the Confederacy's [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Eemon was also backed by a private [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], which he ruthlessly used to eliminate threats to his power. The landscape of the once-beautiful Caramm V was thus destroyed in the process of the planet's ravaging.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ado Eemon was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book authored by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
